def getTasksAsJson(documentIdString, parentTagEncoded, applicationSecret) = Action { implicit request =>
  validateApplicationSecret(applicationSecret)
  ...findById(documentId)
  val tasks = ...filter(TaskEntity.documentId === documentId).data().sorted
  val parentAndBelow = tasks.dropWhile(t => !(t.tags contains parentTag))
  require(parentAndBelow.nonEmpty, s"Could not find $parentTag")
  val parent = parentAndBelow.head
  val tasksToReturn = parentAndBelow.takeWhile(t => t == parent || t.indentation > parent.indentation)
  Ok(toJson(tasksToReturn))
}

_output_schema.tasks: JSON array of tasks under parentTag (contentHtml, indentation, collapsed, checked, tags)

summary: Piga is a Scala/Play + Scala.js hierarchical task-list editor for power users: users log in (SHA-512 password hash), create/edit/remove tasks and documents via a generic EntityModification RPC API, share documents between users via DocumentPermissionAndPlacement rows, and drive an external/task-tag automation API (insert/read tasks, regenerate order tokens, process #delayed_tasks); every mutation is duplicated as an immutable EntityModificationEntity audit log row.
